tpms.when: 2022, set from the multi-information display between the gauges (no reset button)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the driver's door jamb sticker.
Park somewhere safe and turn the vehicle to ON.
Use the arrow buttons on the steering wheel to go to the settings screen on the display between the gauges, then choose Vehicle Settings and press OK.
Choose Set Pressure, then press and hold OK until the tire pressure light blinks 3 times.
tpms.note: If the tire pressure light flashes for about a minute and then stays on, the system has a fault. A reset will not clear it; have it checked.
